facts.fact: The PDEX page says all integrations of the Consular Portal with the civil identification system run through PDEX, giving access to citizens' data; it does not say the portal verifies people.
The PDEX page says public and private entities already use the citizen data validation APIs on PDEX in their digital processes; it names no entity and gives no count.
